title: Prosecution spox: Sara Duterte-linked Gencorp Industries is Chinese-owned
summary: House Prosecution spokesperson Zia Alonto Adiong on Saturday questioned the Duterte camp’s public posture toward China and cited a corporate link that the prosecution says warrants closer examination.
